protocol.model: linear logit on training-standardized raw features, unpenalized intercept
protocol.initialization: BCE from prevalence intercept; every other objective uses BCE at the same lambda
protocol.weighted_control: weights 1,sqrt(31),31; weight-one candidates reuse BCE exactly
protocol.selection: validation hard F1, then validation log loss, then lambda and positive weight
protocol.threshold: all realizable validation tied-score groups; same selection for every method
protocol.primary: held-out deterministic F1 at the selected validation threshold
protocol.synthetic: Gaussian class conditionals, eight features, class-one mean shift 1.25 or 2.5
protocol.real: case-control subsamples of public Banknote and Spambase; disjoint within each split seed
limits: ordinary classical expected-utility training; no collapse-specific architecture or novelty claim
one convex logit family; no neural or boosting superiority claim
numerical exact-expectation formula, not an outward enclosure
metric losses nonconvex; numerical convergence does not prove global optimality
three candidates per metric method versus nine weighted-BCE candidates; unequal compute/tuning
case-control real-data results do not describe natural prevalence
real-data seeds share source observations and are not independent datasets
small pilot; no significance, population or deterministic-metric gradient guarantee
